langs.name: Spanish
langs.intro: 8 course words and 14 course sentences from each source. Words come first; the first six words have a Lingua Libre recording. The course now uses Kokoro em_alex for every clip without a native recording.
langs.scoreNote: Whisper large-v3 (int8, CPU, single thread; multi-threaded int8 gave random wrong transcripts on this machine, so these replace the earlier numbers) transcribes each clip. Words heard right: exact match after lowercasing and removing punctuation, so 'veinte' heard as '20' counts as a miss for every source, including the native one. Sentence WER/CER: word and character error rate against the sentence text, lower is better. A second set of 30 other course sentences was scored too; see the notes.

langs.name: English
langs.intro: 8 course words and 14 course sentences from each source (General American). All eight words have a Lingua Libre recording. A second set of 16 words and 30 sentences was scored for the top voices and the previous one; single words separate the voices, sentences are near-perfect for all.
langs.scoreNote: Whisper large-v3 on CPU transcribes each clip (int8 single-thread for most rows; LJSpeech, lessac, MeloTTS and the second set for af_heart/af_bella used float32, which gives the same transcripts). Words heard right: exact match after lowercasing, removing punctuation and spelling out digits. Sentence WER/CER: word and character error rate, lower is better. A box restart cut the second-set run short, so not every voice has second-set numbers.

langs.name: Portuguese
langs.intro: 8 course words and 14 course sentences from each source (Brazilian Portuguese). A second set of 16 words and 30 sentences was scored for every voice. Only 4 of the 8 words here have a Brazilian native recording (335 of 600 course words do); Tatoeba has no openly licensed Portuguese sentence audio.
langs.scoreNote: Whisper large-v3 (float32, CPU) transcribes each clip. Words heard right: exact match after lowercasing, removing punctuation and spelling out digits; Whisper often mishears isolated short Portuguese words even from native speakers, so word scores are noisy and sentences weigh more. Sentence WER/CER: word and character error rate, lower is better.

candidates.label: Native recording (Lingua Libre / Commons, Brazilian speakers)

langs.name: French
langs.intro: 8 course words and 14 course sentences from each source (France French). A second set of 16 words and 30 sentences was scored for every voice. Every course word has a native recording (600 of 600); 4 of the 14 sentences here have an openly licensed Tatoeba recording (96 course sentences do).
langs.scoreNote: Whisper large-v3 (float32, CPU) transcribes each clip. Words heard right: exact match after lowercasing, removing punctuation and spelling out digits; Whisper often mishears isolated short French words even from native speakers (bar → barre, corps → cours, il → île), so word scores are noisy and sentences weigh more. Sentence WER/CER: word and character error rate, lower is better.

candidates.label: Native recording (Lingua Libre / Commons words, Tatoeba sentences)
candidates.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 / CC BY 4.0 / CC0 / CC BY 2.0 FR
candidates.note: second set: 8/16 words, sentence WER 8.7% (Whisper hears the short Tatoeba clip 'Garde ça.' as 'Merci.'). France French Lingua Libre speakers (LoquaxFR, Sartus85, Poslovitch and six others); Tatoeba sentences by vlecomte.

candidates.label: Kokoro-82M v1.0, ff_siwis (chosen)
candidates.note: second set: 11/16 words, sentence WER 7.1%; first set 4.3%. Best voice with a fully documented open license once tom was excluded. Weak on isolated words in the first set (tous and pour come out like numbers), but every course word has a native recording, so it voices sentences only.

candidates.label: Piper fr_FR tom medium (not used)
candidates.note: second set: 11/16 words, sentence WER 5.1%. Scored best (17 of 24 words over both sets; sentence WER 4.3% / 5.1%), but not used: its model card and training repo do not say which checkpoint it was fine-tuned from, and nearly every French Piper voice was fine-tuned from the English lessac or ryan voices, whose base data is not openly licensed.

langs.name: Italian
langs.intro: 8 course words and 14 course sentences from each source. A second set of 16 words and 30 sentences (8 with a Tatoeba recording) was scored for every voice. 517 of 600 course words have a native recording; 74 course sentences have an openly licensed Tatoeba recording (all by NM1); 1 was dropped after a Whisper check and 42 for clipping, so 32 are used. Piper it_IT paola was not tested: it was fine-tuned from the English lessac voice, whose base data is not openly licensed.
langs.scoreNote: Whisper large-v3 (float32, CPU) transcribes each clip. Words heard right: exact match after lowercasing, removing punctuation and spelling out digits. Sentence WER/CER: word and character error rate, lower is better.

langs.name: German
langs.intro: 8 course words and 14 course sentences from each source. A second set of 16 words and 30 sentences (8 with a Tatoeba recording) was scored for every voice except the Chatterbox reference-voice retest. All 600 course words have a native recording; 106 course sentences have an openly licensed Tatoeba recording (by Yeti and MisterTrouser, CC BY 4.0); 2 were dropped after a Whisper check, so 104 are used. Not tested: every Piper de_DE Thorsten voice, karlsson and kerstin (fine-tuned from the English lessac or ryan voices, whose base data is not openly licensed), pavoque (non-commercial data), Orpheus German (Llama 3.2 licence, 3B parameters, far too slow on CPU) and Zonos (training data undisclosed).
langs.scoreNote: Whisper large-v3 (float32, CPU) transcribes each clip. Words heard right: exact match after lowercasing, removing punctuation and spelling out digits. Sentence WER/CER: word and character error rate, lower is better. Speed is CPU seconds per clip on the build machine.

candidates.label: Native recording (Lingua Libre / Commons words, Tatoeba sentences)
candidates.note: second set: 16/16 words, sentence WER 0%. Words mostly by Natschoba, Jeuwre and Sebastian Wallroth on Lingua Libre plus other Commons uploads; Tatoeba sentences by Yeti and MisterTrouser (CC BY 4.0).

candidates.label: Coqui TTS Thorsten VITS (chosen)
candidates.note: second set: 5/16 words, sentence WER 2.1%. Lowest sentence error over both sets combined (9.3% / 2.1%) and fastest (0.4 s per clip). Trained from scratch (no base checkpoint) on the CC0 Thorsten-Voice Dec2021 neutral dataset. Isolated words are weaker, but every course word has a native recording.
